profiles.selection_note: Software-only baseline; it has no FPGA top to generate.

definitions.bram18_equiv: Block RAM use converted to RAMB18 equivalents: 2 * RAMB36 + RAMB18.
definitions.design: Vivado top-level design name used for implementation.
definitions.design_state: Implementation state of the reports, normally Routed for final bitstream reports.
definitions.device: Target FPGA/SoC part used by Vivado.
definitions.dsp: DSP block count used by the implemented design.
definitions.ff: Flip-flop count reported at the implemented top level.
definitions.fmax_mhz: Estimated maximum clock frequency from the worst setup slack: 1000 / (target_period_ns - worst_slack_ns).
definitions.logic_lut: LUTs used as combinational/sequential logic, excluding LUTRAM and SRL usage.
definitions.lut: Total LUT count reported at the implemented top level, including logic and LUTRAM/SRL use.
definitions.pl_power_w: Estimated Programmable Logic plus non-PS on-chip power in watts, computed as total_power_w - ps_power_w.
definitions.pl_static_power_w: Estimated static/leakage power attributed to the Programmable Logic.
definitions.power_confidence: Vivado's confidence level for the power estimate; Medium usually means vectorless or incomplete activity data.
definitions.ps_power_w: Estimated Processing System power in watts, from the PS8 row.
definitions.ps_static_power_w: Estimated static/leakage power attributed to the Processing System.
definitions.ramb18: Number of 18 Kb block RAM primitives used.
definitions.ramb36: Number of 36 Kb block RAM primitives used.
definitions.static_power_w: Estimated device static/leakage power in watts.
definitions.target_period_ns: Requested clock period constraint in nanoseconds.
definitions.timing_met: True when the worst reported setup slack is non-negative.
definitions.total_power_w: Total estimated on-chip power in watts from Vivado power analysis.
definitions.worst_slack_ns: Worst setup slack in nanoseconds; positive means timing margin remains.
